== Official partial-slip source ==
The source is the unchanged official Set 7 PDF, printed edition September 2023, page 2. PDF SHA-256 <code>597c96306746c8958d56283651afdf714ff23b88e847e86bbc39e319c578e363</code>. Image xref12 SHA-256 <code>d57b7417538e9a2f8303791f4c6b2146c306210c44bae90feaf3446f66389919</code>; original mask xref11 stream SHA-256 <code>de2f895e5e3c01e23774aa32fd0a495423da49d78418874906be48469ba1db65</code>. The embedded panel is 745×338 and intentionally omits the upper face. No image was repainted or completed.

The existing current full image is evidenced in Holotable by 4 November 2022; the documented sheet edition is September 2023. This orders the source editions used in the draft, not an asserted first publication day for the partial layout. A bounded 2022–2024  CDX query returned an empty list; the official 2017 design announcement proves the card’s earlier release but not this particular image edition. PDF metadata does not establish the publication date.

Existing supported family <code>207_4</code> is preserved. No new executable ID or Card redirect is created. Article numbering follows the existing visible-version family pattern; the source’s actual printed errata mark is recorded separately.
